image_description: A close-up view of a bakery display case containing various baked goods. The foreground features several round, pale loaves of bread (possibly sourdough or white bread) dusted with flour on wooden boards. Behind them is a large rectangular chocolate cake or brownie slab. In the background, through the glass shelves, other pastries and a person in a red shirt are partially visible. The setting appears to be inside a commercial bakery.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the bread crusts appears slightly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the fine micro-cracks and irregularity typical of real sourdough or artisanal bread. The flour dusting looks somewhat uniformly sprayed rather than naturally settled.

The edges of the chocolate cake are slightly soft and ill-defined, blending into the background shelf. The grid pattern on top lacks sharp geometric precision, suggesting minor generation blur or melting.
The reflection and refraction on the glass shelves are inconsistent. Some edges of the glass seem to disappear or merge with the background items without proper optical distortion.

selected_experts.reason: To verify if the items are correctly classified as bread/cake and not generic food blobs.
To assess the realism of textures (crust, flour) and lighting consistency.
To check for edge bleeding between the glass reflections and the solid objects.
To ensure the depth relationship between the foreground bread and background cake is physically valid.

focus_areas: Texture realism of bread crusts and flour
Geometric integrity of the chocolate cake pattern
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'plastic' sheen on the bread. Real bread usually has a more matte, irregular surface. Also, verify if the glass reflections match the position of the light sources implied by the shadows.
